result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken or missing image placeholder instead of a food photo. Other visual elements (promo banner, carousels, bottom navigation, status bar) render correctly. Clipped carousel items and content cut off at the viewport bottom were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays a broken-image placeholder icon on a flat gray background instead of a restaurant photo, making the top listing look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image URL and add a fallback. Use a branded placeholder or a skeleton loader, and show a proper restaurant image.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the gray placeholder card has weak contrast against its background, so it is hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker or outlined heart button, or add a subtle shadow so the control stands out on light backgrounds.
